description:
Public profile of an Instagram account: bio, avatar, verification/business flags, follower/following/post counts and story-highlight info.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: id (string), username (string), full_name (string), biography (string), external_url (string, nullable), profile_pic_url (string, nullable), profile_pic_url_hd (string, nullable), is_private (boolean), is_verified (boolean), is_business_account (boolean), category_name (string, nullable), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), post_count (integer, nullable), has_highlights (boolean, nullable), highlight_count (integer, nullable).

username.description: Instagram username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "instagram"

name: instagram_profile
title: Instagram profile
